title: notholaena fraseri
intro: Notholaena fraseri, commonly known as Fraser's fern, is a type of fern plant species native to Australia and New Zealand. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Notholaena fraseri include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, which may help alleviate symptoms of colds and flu. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
